items.title: Roy McCurdy interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: I mean Horace wanted me to come out

ctx.x: Yeah. And you’re listening to yourself.

And I’m saying what am I doing here you know, in this place. And so it was about, I had been there almost a year and I got several calls, I mean Horace wanted me to come out and a couple of the other guys wanted me to come. And then this big chance came with Cannon. Louis Hayes was leaving to go with Oscar Peterson, and Cannon called and he said, I think his exact words were “Fool — I want you to come join my band.” So I said oh, man, what am I going to do about this? You know I was really tired of Kodak and so I…
